items.title: Rigor Compresses: Why AI Agents Need Graphs, Not More Context
items.summary: AI编码智能体在处理局部代码时表现出色，但在回答"修改此函数会影响谁"、"迁移是否具有破坏性"等全局性问题时常常猜测出错。作者认为，提升智能体能力的关键不在于提供更多上下文，而在于交付经过验证的事实——这些事实大多可建模为图结构（如调用图、控制流图、数据流图），通过可达性分析、拓扑排序、强连通分量、支配关系等图算法，将复杂的全局依赖关系转化为简洁、可验证的断言，从而让每个token都承载高信噪比的信息。
items.why_now: AI Agent 时代让图谱分析从高门槛变刚需，刚成独立开发者新机会。
items.summary_en: AI coding agents excel at local edits but struggle with global questions like impact analysis, ordering, and data flow—problems that are fundamentally graph-based (reachability, topological sort, dominance, etc.). The key to token efficiency is not more context but handing agents verified, high-signal facts derived from dependency and control-flow graphs, formatted concisely with evidence. Graph theory is becoming more practical as AI lowers the barrier to implementing these algorithms, making graph-derived facts the most leverageable tool for reliable agent reasoning.

items.title: Show HN: An open source job search plugin for Claude Code
items.summary: 一个开源的 Claude Code 插件可将 Claude 转变为求职助手：用户安装后运行 `/job-search`，Claude 会询问目标职位偏好并保存到本地，再通过 agent-data 工具实时抓取 LinkedIn 职位列表，对比偏好后生成匹配的岗位摘要；支持按计划（如每日）定时推送新增的匹配岗位；底层依赖 agent-data 的结构化网页数据 API（无需绑定信用卡），代码以 MIT 协议开源发布在 GitHub。
items.why_now: 该插件刚在HN发布，Claude Code生态正热，开源免费且无需信用卡即可上手。
items.summary_en: Here's an open source plugin that turns Claude Code into a job search assistant: users install it, run `/job-search`, answer preference questions, and Claude pulls live LinkedIn Jobs postings, compares them against saved preferences, and generates a digest of relevant matches. It supports scheduled daily searches and plans include resume-to-job-fit scoring and resume edit recommendations. The plugin uses the agent-data tool for structured web data and requires a free API key (no credit card).

items.title: Show HN: A free CLI coding agent, powered by ads
items.summary: 该工具是一款免费的命令行编码代理，通过广告补贴方式为用户提供 DeepSeek 4.0 和 MiniMax M3 等主流大模型的使用权限，无需用户直接付费即可调用这些模型进行代码生成与辅助编程。
items.summary_en: Launching a free CLI coding agent that subsidizes access to models like DeepSeek 4.0 and MiniMax M3, funded by ads. The tool offers AI-powered coding assistance at no cost to users, with revenue generated through advertising. It’s currently gaining traction on Hacker News with 6 points and 7 comments.

items.title: Lore – Open source version control system designed for scalability
items.summary: Lore 是一个专为可扩展性设计的开源版本控制系统，旨在解决现有方案在大规模场景下的性能瓶颈。该系统通过优化数据结构和分布式架构，显著提升了处理海量代码仓库和高并发操作的能力，相比传统版本控制工具在扩展性方面具有明显优势。
items.summary_en: Lore is an open-source version control system built for scalability, designed to handle large-scale projects with high performance. It emphasizes efficient handling of massive repositories and complex workflows, targeting enterprise and large-team use cases. The project has gained significant traction, with 975 points and 533 comments on Hacker News, indicating strong community interest.

items.title: 刚刚，北京建了一座AI工厂：目标10万P算力，日产10万亿Token！
items.summary: 北京建成一座AI工厂，目标算力达10万P，每日可产出10万亿Token，标志着大规模AI基础设施建设的重大进展。该工厂将显著提升AI模型的训练与推理能力，为各类AI应用提供强大支撑。此举有望加速AI技术在各行业的落地与普及。
items.summary_en: Beijing has launched an AI factory targeting 100,000 PetaFLOPS of computing power and a daily output of 10 trillion tokens, marking a major infrastructure push to scale large-scale AI model training and inference. The facility underscores China's strategic investment in domestic AI capacity, aiming to support next-generation foundation models and reduce reliance on foreign hardware. Specific technical architecture and operational timelines were not disclosed in the report.

items.title: 头部具身大脑公司再获数亿美元融资！世界模型路线，15家VC抢着投
items.summary: 一家头部具身智能大脑企业刚刚完成新一轮数亿美元融资，估值持续走高。该公司主打「世界模型（World Model）」路线，吸引了多达15家顶级VC竞相入局。本轮资金将主要用于世界模型算法迭代与具身大脑的大规模落地。
items.summary_en: A leading embodied brain company has secured hundreds of millions of dollars in new funding, with 15 venture capital firms competing to invest. The company is pursuing a world model approach, signaling strong investor confidence in its technical direction.

items.title: Omnigent开源：AI智能体团队元框架
items.summary: Omnigent 是由 Databricks AI 团队及传奇人物 Matei Zaharia 开发的开源 AI 智能体元框架，允许用户在一个实时会话中同时运行 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Pi 及自定义智能体，实现多智能体协作编程。该框架基于 Databricks 内部开发工具构建，旨在将编程模式从单一智能体升级为完整的 AI 智能体团队。
items.summary_en: Omnigent is an open-source meta-framework for running multi-agent teams (including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents) in a single real-time session, built on Databricks' internal development tools by Matei Zaharia and the Databricks AI team. It addresses the evolution from single-agent to team-based AI workflows in programming. The framework is now publicly available as part of the open-source release.

items.title: Show HN: Free Alternative to Crunchbase
items.summary: 这是一个免费的 Crunchbase 替代产品，利用 AI 团队自动收集和撰写初创公司资料，API 密钥同样免费开放，并计划每日持续新增更多公司档案。
items.summary_en: A new free alternative to Crunchbase has been launched, using teams of AI agents to automatically assemble and write startup profiles. The product also offers a free API key and plans to add more profiles daily. Currently, it received 3 points and no comments on Hacker News at the time of this summary.

items.title: Only 16 Percent of Americans Think AI Will Have a Positive Impact on Society
items.summary: 根据一项最新调查，仅有16%的美国人认为AI将对社会产生积极影响，反映出公众对AI技术的高度担忧。该研究揭示了美国社会对人工智能发展的普遍悲观情绪，与AI行业快速发展形成鲜明对比。
items.summary_en: A new study reveals that only 16% of Americans believe AI will positively impact society, highlighting widespread public skepticism despite rapid AI adoption. The findings, reported by TechCrunch, underscore growing concerns about AI’s societal implications amid ongoing debates on ethics, job displacement, and misinformation.

items.title: 阿里云发布HappyOyster 1.0：一句话生成可实时交互的数字世界
items.summary: 6月17日，阿里云发布开放式世界模型HappyOyster 1.0，基于原生多模态架构，支持多模态输入与音视频联合生成，可在生成过程中持续接收用户指令并实时响应画面，深度学习物理世界状态转移规律以保持人物和环境长程一致性。官网开放"实时导演"与"世界探索"两种玩法，前者支持随时叫停改写故事、与虚拟男友实时互动，后者支持自由漫游、滑板冲刺、翼装滑翔、骑马奔驰、攻击打怪等交互。该产品已于4月16日开放内测，即日起至7月17日官网不定期掉落体验积分。
items.summary_en: Alibaba Cloud released HappyOyster 1.0, an open-world model with native multimodal architecture that jointly generates audiovisual content and supports real-time interactive storytelling using physics-based rules for consistent character/environment continuity. The product features two core modes: "real-time directing" for dynamic plot changes and character interactions, and "world exploration" for free-roaming action scenarios. It is currently in beta with limited access, distributing demo credits through July 17.

directions.name: DepGraph
directions.description: 一个 VS Code 插件，实时分析代码库的调用图和数据流图，在 AI 编码智能体修改代码前自动回答'会影响谁'和'是否具有破坏性'。
directions.target_user: 使用 Cursor/Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具的全栈开发者
core_features: 实时生成函数级调用图和数据流图
在 AI 智能体提交修改前自动标注影响范围和高风险依赖
一键生成'安全修改建议'供 AI 智能体参考
directions.why_now: DEV Community 文章指出 AI 编码智能体在处理全局依赖问题时频繁出错，而 Reddit/Hacker News 上 'ai agent' 被 3 个源热议，说明开发者对 AI 编码可靠性痛点高度关注。当前市场缺乏专门针对 AI 智能体上下文质量的工具，而非更多上下文。
directions.monitization: 免费基础版（单文件分析）+ 付费团队版（全仓库图分析、CI/CD 集成），$15/月/人
directions.source_article: Rigor Compresses: Why AI Agents Need Graphs, Not More Context

directions.name: AgentOrchestrator
directions.description: 一个轻量级 Web 控制台，让独立开发者在一个界面中同时调度 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等多个 AI 智能体，分配子任务并汇总结果。
directions.target_user: 一人公司创业者和独立开发者，希望用多智能体协作加速产品开发
core_features: 统一仪表盘管理多个 AI 智能体会话
智能任务拆分：输入需求，自动分配给最适合的智能体
结果聚合与冲突检测：自动合并各智能体输出并标记矛盾
directions.why_now: Omnigent 开源引发社区对多智能体协作编程的热议，'ai agent' 在 3 个源被报道。但 Omnigent 面向企业级用户，独立开发者需要更轻量、即开即用的方案。Reddit 上已有开发者抱怨'同时开多个 AI 工具太混乱'，需求明确。
directions.monitization: 免费 3 个智能体 + 无限智能体 $29/月，按使用量计费
directions.source_article: Omnigent开源：AI智能体团队元框架
